plan.goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full stripe-docs system, prioritizing the primary docs/tutorial flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
plan.summary: The exploration will start by verifying global navigation, including the side nav, top nav, and the search dialog. It will then deep-dive into the primary 'Hosted quickstart' tutorial, interacting with code blocks (language switchers, copy buttons). Following that, it will validate the adjacent 'Embedded' and 'Customization' pages to ensure state consistency and content accuracy. Finally, it will rigorously test the mobile viewport, focusing on how the complex 3-column layout collapses and whether the identified small tap targets cause usability issues.
assumptions: The search dialog is functional and can be opened via click or the '/' shortcut.
Code blocks have interactive language switchers and copy buttons that provide feedback.
External links (e.g., to Stripe official docs or Dashboard) are marked or behave predictably, though the agent will focus primarily on local pages.
The 3-column layout (left nav, center content, right outline) collapses into a single column or uses hamburger menus on mobile.
risk_hotspots: Search dialog functionality and dismissal (keyboard vs mouse).
Code block interactions (language tabs, copy button state changes).
Scroll-spy behavior on the right-side outline (if implemented).
Small tap targets (navigation links, copy buttons, feedback buttons) on mobile viewports.
Navigation state consistency (active states in left/top nav across different pages).

phases.title: Global Navigation & Search
phases.objective: Validate top and side navigation mechanisms and the search dialog functionality.
key_checks: Click top nav links (Hosted, Embedded, Customization) to verify routing.
Click left nav links to verify routing.
Open search dialog via click on the search input/button.
Open search dialog via the '/' keyboard shortcut (if possible).
Close the search dialog via click outside or 'Esc'.
exit_criteria: Navigated successfully between local HTML pages using both top and side menus.
Search dialog opened and closed successfully.

phases.title: Core Tutorial Interactions
phases.objective: Exercise the rich interactive elements within the main tutorial content.
key_checks: Click code block language switchers (e.g., 'Node') and verify code content updates.
Click 'Copy' buttons on code blocks and look for success feedback.
Scroll through the page and observe if the right-side outline updates (scroll-spy).
Interact with feedback buttons ('Yes' / 'No') at the bottom of the page.
exit_criteria: Copy buttons clicked and feedback observed.

phases.title: Adjacent Pages Validation
phases.objective: Ensure secondary pages load correctly and maintain navigation state.
key_checks: Navigate to embedded.html and verify the active state in the left nav.
Interact with code blocks specific to embedded.html.
Navigate to customization.html and verify content loads correctly.
Check external links to 'Branding settings' for proper attributes (e.g., target='_blank').
exit_criteria: Both embedded.html and customization.html visited and core elements interacted with.

phases.title: Mobile Responsiveness & Usability
phases.objective: Evaluate layout collapse and tap target sizes on mobile.
key_checks: Verify how the left sidebar and right outline collapse (e.g., hidden behind a menu toggle).
Attempt to tap small targets flagged in the prescan (e.g., 'Copy' buttons, 'Yes'/'No' buttons, specific nav links).
Open search dialog on mobile and verify it is usable.
exit_criteria: Mobile layout verified, menu toggles exercised, and small tap targets tested for usability.

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 3 known HTML pages (index.html, embedded.html, customization.html).
coverage_targets.features: Exercise search dialog, code block tabs/copy buttons, and navigation menus.
coverage_targets.mobile: Test responsive layout collapse and interact with flagged small tap targets on mobile.

notes: Pay special attention to the layout warnings regarding small tap targets. These should be a primary focus during the mobile evaluation phase.
Be cautious of external links (e.g., docs.stripe.com, dashboard.stripe.com) to avoid leaving the local test environment unintentionally.
